rationale: FP16_Optimizer.get_grad_norm wrongly skips tp_rank>0 slices for genuine TP-sliced params. Reported total_norm is finite, valid-looking, ~1/sqrt(tp_size) of truth. Per anti-example 11, detection requires running a TP=1 reference with same seed/batch and comparing grad-norm — implementation_equivalence with no observable runtime field that reveals the mistake on a single buggy run. Therefore source-only: pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6. category=gradient_sync because root cause is reduction-mask logic, not communication-group misconfig (anti-example 3).
